001package pkg_commands;
002
003import pkg_engine.GameEngine;
004
005/**
006 * Implements the {@code quit} command, ending the game when the syntax is valid.
007 *
008 * @author Barnabe Jouanard
009 * @version 2026.05.08
010 */
011public class QuitCommand extends Command {
012    /** Creates the command. */
013    public QuitCommand() {}
014
015    /**
016     * Ends the game when no extra word is provided.
017     *
018     * @param pGameEngine the game engine to close
019     * @return {@code true} when the game is ending
020     */
021    public boolean execute(final GameEngine pGameEngine) {
022        if (this.hasSecondWord()) {
023            pGameEngine.getGui().println("Quit what?");
024            return false;
025    }
026        pGameEngine.getGui().println("Thank you for playing! Goodbye.");
027        pGameEngine.endGame();
028        return true;
029    } // execute()
030}
